fields.name: NOTICES
fields.value: a. Any notices required under the Contract shall be in writing and sent by registered mail, courier, or email to the respective Parties at their addresses or email addresses specified in the Contract. b. Notices shall be deemed to have been received: i. In the case of registered mail, five days after posting; ii. In the case of courier, on the date of delivery; iii. In the case of email, on the date the email is sent, provided there is no automated failure message. c. Either Party may change its address or email for notices by giving the other Party written notice of the new address or email.

fields.name: NOTIFICATION OF BREACH
fields.value: Vendor is required to notify the buyer within 72 hrs in writing of any breaches or potential breaches of this contract as soon as they become aware of such occurrences. This notification must include a detailed description of the nature of the breach, the circumstances surrounding it, and any relevant information that may assist in the resolution of the issue. Failure to provide timely notification may result in the cancellation of the contract and vendor being held liable for any resulting damages or losses incurred by the buyer.

fields.name: COUNTERPARTS
fields.value: The Contract may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be deemed as original, but all of which together shall constitute one and the same Contract. Signatures delivered electronically (e.g., via email or an electronic signature platform) shall be deemed valid and binding for all purposes.

fields.name: SEVERABILITY
fields.value: If any provision of the Contract is found to be invalid, illegal, or unenforceable by a court of competent jurisdiction, such provision shall be deemed severed from the Contract, and the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect. The Parties shall use their best efforts to negotiate a valid and enforceable replacement provision that reflects the original intent of the severed provision.

fields.name: WAIVER
fields.value: No waiver of any provision of the Contract by either Party shall be effective unless made in writing and signed by the waiving Party. The failure of either Party to enforce any provision of the Contract shall not be construed as a waiver of that provision or any other provisions, nor affect the validity of the Contract.

fields.name: SURVIVAL
fields.value: The provisions of the Contract that are inherently intended to survive termination or expiry (including but not limited to warranties, indemnities, confidentiality obligations, and dispute resolution provisions) shall survive the termination or expiry of the Contract.

fields.name: THIRD-PARTY RIGHTS
fields.value: Unless otherwise expressly provided in the Contract, no person other than the Buyer and the Vendor shall have any rights to enforce any term of the Contract.

fields.name: INDEMNITY
fields.value: The Vendor agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the Buyer, its affiliates, employees, and agents from and against any and all claims, damages, liabilities, costs, or expenses (including legal fees) arising from or in connection with: a. Any breach of the Vendor`s obligations under the Contract; b. Injury or damage to property or persons (including death) resulting from the Vendor`s actions or omissions; c. Defects in the Deliverables supplied or the Vendor`s failure to comply with applicable laws, regulations, or standards. d. Any claims arising from infringement of third-party intellectual property rights due to the use, sale, or distribution of the Deliverables under the Contract.

fields.name: TERMINATION
fields.value: a. The Buyer reserves the right to terminate the Contract, in whole or in part, with immediate effect by providing written notice to the Vendor in the event of: i. The Vendor`s breach of any material term or condition of the Contract or it is evident that such breach will occur and if not remedied within 14 days of receiving notice of the breach; ii. The Vendor`s insolvency, bankruptcy, or appointment of a receiver or administrator; iii. Any Force Majeure event that continues for more than 30 days. b. Upon termination, the Buyer shall be entitled to a refund of any payments made for undelivered or non-conforming Deliverables. c. The Buyer may terminate the Contract for convenience by giving the Vendor 30 days` written notice. In such a case, the Vendor shall be entitled to payment for any Deliverables already delivered and accepted by the Buyer but shall not be entitled to any further compensation or damages. d. Termination of the Contract shall not affect the accrued rights, remedies, obligations, or liabilities of the parties existing at termination. Conditions that expressly or by implication survive termination of the Contract shall continue in full force and effect.

fields.name: DISPUTE RESOLUTION AND GOVERNING LAW
fields.value: a. The Contract, including any disputes or claims arising out of or in connection with it, shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Indonesia, excluding its conflicts of law provisions. b. Disputes between the Parties, including those related to interpretation, performance, breach, or termination of the Contract, shall first be attempted to be resolved amicably through negotiation within thirty (30) calendar days from the date of written notice of the dispute by either Party. c. If amicable resolution fails, disputes shall be resolved by arbitration under the Indonesian National Board of Arbitration (BANI) Rules and Law No. 30 Year 1999 regarding Arbitration and Alternative Dispute Resolution. The arbitration panel shall consist of three arbitrators: one appointed by ESSA, one appointed by the Buyer, and a third, who will act as the chairman, appointed by the first two arbitrators or, failing agreement, by the Chairman of BANI. The arbitration will be conducted in Jakarta, Indonesia, in English. d. For international contracts, disputes shall be resolved by arbitration administered by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) in accordance with the SIAC Rules. e. Provisions regarding Governing Law and Arbitration shall survive termination or expiration of the Contract.

fields.name: CODE OF BUSINESS CONDUCT
fields.value: a) The Vendor acknowledges that it has read, understands, and agrees to comply with the Buyer`s Code of Business Conduct, which outlines the Buyer`s commitment to ethical business practices, corporate responsibility, and compliance with legal standards. b) The Vendor shall ensure that its employees, agents, and subcontractors adhere to the principles of the Buyer`s Code of Business Conduct [under development] in the performance of their obligations under this Contract. c) The Vendor agrees to conduct its business in a manner consistent with the highest ethical standards, including but not limited to compliance with human rights, fair competition, and sustainability practices.

fields.name: COMPLIANCE VERIFICATION
fields.value: a) The Buyer reserves the right to review the Vendor`s records and processes, including those of any subcontractors, to ensure compliance with the terms of the Contract and the Buyer`s Code of Business Conduct, including but not limited to quality and adherence to applicable laws and regulations. b) Such reviews may be conducted with reasonable notice during normal business hours. The Vendor shall provide full cooperation and grant access to relevant records, facilities, and personnel to support the review.
